title: UAAP: Ateneo women clobber UE to regain winning ways
summary: Ateneo de Manila University cruised past University of the East, 73-56, for a triumphant end to the first round of the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament on Sunday at the Blue Eagle Gym.
